thread:
alice: heads-up — deploybot flagged a long-running CI job blocking the promote. job=build/packager-shard-17 stuck on fetch-cache for 32m, all shards waiting.
deploy-bot: [ALERT] promote: release/2026-03-21 stuck — job build/packager-shard-17 timed out fetching remote cache (attempts=5). See logs: http://ci.internal/logs/4822001111
ben: oof. which step exactly? is it network or remote cache lease?
alice: looks like bazel worker stuck on downloading blobs, repeated s3 499 on multipart objects. logs show repeated reconnects.
carol: +1 seeing same in other shards — but only 17 is stuck in a tight retry loop. others finished but waiting on promotion gate.
dmitri: is this the same cache namespace we rotated keys for yesterday? could be TTL/rotation mismatch.
alice: maybe. cache-key prefix: release/2026-03-21/packager. rotation was rolled at 03:00 UTC. shard 17 might have an old session.
ben: quick mitigation options: 1) restart the runner for shard-17 (ephemeral) 2) clear that shard's cache entry 3) promote last-good image (rollback) 4) force promote bypass (not ideal).
carol: we have a 15:00 UTC release window. if we wait for runner restart + rerun shard it's ~20-25m. rollback/pin would unblock immediately but loses new commits.
dmitri: agree. let's attempt runner restart then rerun the single shard. if that fails, pin to last-good image.
alice: I'll trigger a soft restart on the runner. ben can you prep the pin command if needed?
ben: on it. pin command: `deployctl promote --pin-digest sha256:abcd1234 --env prod` (dry-run first).
dmitri: also adding a throttled cache-clear for that prefix: `POST /internal/cache/clear?prefix=release/2026-03-21/packager&shard=17` to avoid blowing up other shards. use rate-limit 1r/s.
carol: pls add an incident note if we opt to pin. want traceability for postmortem.
alice: runner restart triggered (runner-id: runner-ec2-5g). watch logs.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] restart job build/packager-shard-17 requested by alice. estimated rerun ETA 3m.
ben: rerun kicked off. seeing new worker claim.
alice: logs show fetch retries dropped from 5/s to 2/s already. cc @dmitri for cache rotation check.
dmitri: rotation appears fine; the old session token was still referenced by the runner image. rolling ephemeral token refresh should fix.
carol: rerun succeeded for shard-17 — artifacts uploaded. auto-gate still waiting on final promote checks.
ben: running promote dry-run now. everything green except a lint warning (non-blocking).
alice: decision: proceed with promote. will not pin. document in release notes that we had transient cache fetch errors and we restarted a runner.
dmitri: follow-up: engineering infra will add a guard to avoid stale session tokens in runners (task queued).
carol: leaving a reminder to add a regression test for multipart s3 fetch under transient 499s.
alice: closing thread once promote completes. thanks all :thumbsup:
